_golden: GOLDEN REFERENCE (chaptered tour: a software product with 10+ real screens, 2–4 min; autofilm plans it). The structure follows examples/medstat-pilot, the 3:26 production film. Study it, then write YOUR product's film from YOUR docs. Do not copy its lines, its numbers or its product. It is not buildable (no materials). Every _why says what a top crew did and why.
_facts: The docs this film was written from (fictional product): Fieldbook — a desktop data workbench for field ecologists. Imports CSV, Excel and GPX tracks; species names are checked against GBIF while you import. Cleaning tools: merge sites, fix coordinates, rename taxa in bulk. 40 analyses: diversity indices, rarefaction, occupancy models, ordination (NMDS, PCA), GLMMs. Figures at 300 or 600 DPI. One-click Word report; every analysis also exports its R script. An optional AI explains results; it receives summary tables, never raw records, and works with a local model. macOS and Windows. Free for students.

_anchors.proposition: A field season should end in findings, not in a week of spreadsheet repair.
_anchors.concept: From the notebook to the paper, in one place
_anchors.hook: Three months in the field. Three weeks in spreadsheets.
_anchors.hero: Fieldbook. From the field, to the finding.
_anchors.last: Three months in the field. One afternoon to the finding.
_anchors._why: Even a long tour has ONE idea. The hook names the pain in the audience's own units (months, weeks); every chapter removes part of it; the last line repeats the hook with the product's change in it.

motto: Three months in the field. One afternoon to the finding.

scenes._why: Hook first, over the best real output (not the home screen): a calm second of the whole result, a push into the ordination plot, and the line that names the pain. The name comes after (~5 s).

say.en: Three months in the field. Three weeks in spreadsheets.
say.zh: 野外三个月，表格里三个星期。

scenes._why: Four chores the audience has done, in their words. No adjectives.

say.en: Merge the sites, check the names, switch tools, retype the tables.
say.zh: 合并样地、核对物种名、换软件、手抄表格。

title.en: From the field, to the finding

scenes._why: The map before the journey: the chapters to come, drawn in code from the film's own chapter names, so the map and the film always agree. One sentence says the whole path; the chapters then walk it.

say.en: From the field sheet to the finding, in one place.
say.zh: 从野外记录表到结论，一个地方完成。

scenes._why: Chapter 1 opens on the moment the user's own data arrives. One line says the result (names already checked); the points name where to look.

say.en: Drop in your field sheets. Every species name is checked against GBIF as it comes in.
say.zh: 拖入野外记录表，物种名在导入时就与 GBIF 核对。

scenes._why: Breadth without a list: the rest of the chapter's screens flip by, each named in two or three words. One sentence covers all of them.

say.en: Merge sites, fix coordinates, rename taxa in bulk.
say.zh: 合并样地、修正坐标、批量改名。

scenes._why: Chapter 2: the core job in one gesture (pick, drag, run). The count of analyses comes from the docs, said once.

say.en: Forty analyses, from diversity to occupancy. Pick one, drag in your variables, and run.
say.cap: 40 analyses, from diversity to occupancy. Pick one, drag in your variables, and run.
say.zh: 40 种分析，从多样性到占域模型：选一个，拖入变量，运行。

scenes._why: The second carousel names methods the audience searches for. Specific nouns beat 'powerful models'.

say.zh: 稀疏曲线、占域模型、混合模型。

scenes._why: The breath after two chapters: no picture, the feeling, no new fact.
scenes.zh: 数据还是你的，只是不用再修了。
scenes.en: Your data. Without the repair work.

scenes._why: Chapter 3 is outputs: real figures in a coverflow, the voice names one per item (at), nothing else.

say.en: Site maps, at six hundred DPI.

scenes._why: The take-away: the report and the script. Reproducibility is said as what it lets the user do.

say.en: One click writes the report. Every analysis keeps its R script, so anyone can rerun it.
say.zh: 一键生成报告；每个分析都附 R 脚本，谁都能重跑。

scenes._why: Chapter 4: AI as a colleague, with its limit in the same scene (summary tables only, a local model is possible). The film says the AI text was scripted (in the report and the README, not on screen).

say.en: The assistant explains what the model found. It sees summary tables, never your records.
say.zh: AI 解释模型发现了什么；它只看到汇总表，看不到原始记录。

scenes._why: Why it is new, in rows the docs support. Old way left, new way right, short.

say.en: One workbench instead of four tools, and every result can be rerun.
say.zh: 一个工作台取代四个软件，每个结果都能重跑。

scenes._why: The hero pays off the hook: the cold-open screen returns blurred and the finished figure rises out of it on the downbeat, alone for ~3 s, then the name.

say.en: Fieldbook. From the field, to the finding.

scenes._why: Callback to the hook with the product's change in it. Platforms and price live in chips and contacts.
